reason: In 1 Samuel 10:18-19, Yahweh (speaking through Samuel) explicitly rebukes the people for rejecting Him in favor of requesting a human king. Samuel states: 'Thus says Yahweh...I brought up Israel from Egypt and delivered you...But you have rejected your God (מְאַסְתֶּם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיכֶם) who saves you from all your calamities.' This constitutes a divine complaint about the people's ingratitude and rejection despite Yahweh's past acts of deliverance.
